<task-result id="ReviewConfigAdmissionSpecCR8" agent="code-reviewer" status="completed" duration="6m2s">

<output>
**Mode:** specification (feasibility/correctness), repair pass; candidate `config-admission-resilience-spec-r8`; read-only, no tests executed.

**Prior ledger (CR7 F1–F9): all nine verified closed; none re-raised.**
- **F1** — `Config.ClientTokenHashes()` (internal/config/config.go:81) returns sha256 digests only; it is populated in the parse-time resolution pass (config.go:433), and a validated `client_auth.bearer_tokens` document always yields ≥1 digest (unresolvable → `reference_unresolved`, config.go:927-944). `len(candidate.ClientTokenHashes())>0` is therefore a sound exported refusal predicate; AC8(iii) added.
- **F2** — deterministic seam now specified (spec.md:234, AD21-r8): cmd hook, nil in production, `t.Cleanup` reset, both memo-falsifiers. Feasible: tests already drive `serveWithToolPageSize` and SIGHUP (serve_hybrid_progressive_reveal_test.go:311; serve_hybrid_metadata_defaults_test.go:284).
- **F3** — B changes `storage.directory`; guard rejects (wiring.go:115-116).
- **F4/F5** — hook body split T3 persist/clear vs T4 emission (§6/§10, AC10); §10 readPaths/effects mirror `.omp/plans/execution-state.json:120-147`; whole-repo and build claims removed.
- **F6–F9** — `-race` added; AC12's unobservable clause replaced by I5; settings via staged holder with `Load` unchanged (loop.go:103,137); fingerprint payload removed.

**Scope/coverage.** T1/T2/T3/T4 = 10/4/9/10 paths, mirroring canonical; no `Dockerfile`, no `internal/config`, no T2 live effect; T2 diagnosis-dependence is BLOCKED-with-evidence plus owner-lane AC18 (honest). Tickets 01–04 each map to an R and a runnable oracle; AC15's named tests genuinely do not exist today. Exactly-one emission still holds on the verified call-site set (loop.go:105,110,122,139,159,168; refresh.go:455 never reports). AC14's E1 fixture is constructible: an identical candidate is rejected when `buildReload` discovery fails (reload.go:629-631), and `refresh_interval` admits positive sub-second values (bounds.go:188-196), so a refresh pass follows deterministically.

**Findings (advisory; no HIGH/MEDIUM, no regression)**
- [LOW][ac-not-falsifiable] R6 requires the contract to document "the new events" (three, spec.md:257), but AC15's oracle asserts only the `config_loaded` and `config_degraded` rows (spec.md:289); a missing `config_last_good_write_failed` row would still pass. Fix: require that row in `TestLoggingContractDocumentsConfigEventsAndStorageBase` (file is in T3/T4 sets).
- [LOW][statement-contradiction] AD21's hook boolean is "already memoized" yet "true exactly on the second pre-publication load" (spec.md:96,198). The memo survives publication and AC14 keeps the hook armed until `t.Cleanup` while sending a later SIGHUP (spec.md:288), so a one-shot block would hang. Fix: define it as memoized ∧ `publishedSettings()==nil`, or specify a close-based release.
- [LOW][undefined-term] AD22 layer 1 evaluates `len(candidate.ClientTokenHashes())>0` inside the persist hook (spec.md:204), but the enumerated slot/memo payloads carry only "resolved credential values" (spec.md:202,236); the refusal predicate has no defined carrier. Fix: name it in both payload lists and T3's annotation.
- [LOW][stale-citation] spec.md:96,155,204 cite `config.go:433` as the exported predicate; the method is at config.go:81 — :433 is the digest-append line. Fix: cite :81 for `ClientTokenHashes()`, keep :433 for digest-only population.

### Recommendation
APPROVE
</output>
</task-result>
